sections.text:
Ability Power 240. Damages all enemies 2 times with physical fire damage with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Removes status ailments from all allies.
-Reduces status ailment resistance of all enemies by 30 for 60 seconds.
-Paralyzes all enemies for 60 seconds with a success value of 70.
-Increases the Unison gauge gains of your character by 2 for 50 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases the stats of all allies by 30% for 60 seconds.
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases Unison gauge gains for all allies (excluding your character) by 2 for 50 seconds.
